data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall gross prior year reserve release of GBP 1.094 million in 2016, calculated from the claims development triangle. This release occurred despite a significant gross strengthening of GBP 21.8 million due to the Ogden discount rate change, which primarily impacted UK motor and liability reserves. The overall release suggests that other factors contributed to favorable claims development across older underwriting years, largely offsetting the Ogden impact. Additionally, the syndicate experienced adverse claims experience in Property and Casualty due to unrelated large risk losses and in Marine and Aviation due to two large cargo losses during the current year.
